item.title: EasyBalance：分布式 MoE 推理中的跨层负载均衡
item.summary: arXiv:2608.07964v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Load Balancing has emerged as a critical problem in expert-parallel distributed inference of Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models.
